description: Enroll a user in a course with a given role (StudentEnrollment, TeacherEnrollment, TaEnrollment, ObserverEnrollment, or DesignerEnrollment) and return the created enrollment object, including its `id` and `enrollment_state`. Use `list_course_enrollments` with a `user_id` filter to check a user's existing enrollments before enrolling them again, and `remove_enrollment` to conclude, deactivate, or permanently delete this enrollment afterward — `enroll_user` itself has no way to undo what it creates. Omitting `enrollment_state` leaves it at Canvas's documented default of "invited", so the user must accept a course invitation before the enrollment becomes active; pass `enrollment_state: "active"` to skip that step. Omitting `course_section_id` leaves Canvas to place the enrollment in the course's default section — read `list_sections` for the ID of a specific one. `limit_privileges_to_course_section` confines the user to that section: for teachers and TAs that includes grading privileges, and a section-limited student sees no user outside their own sections, teachers included. Both are left entirely unset when omitted, so the request is unchanged from a call that does not pass them. Requires permission to manage enrollments in the course; Canvas rejects the call otherwise.

course_section_id.description: The section to enroll the user into (from `list_sections`); omitted = the course's default section

limit_privileges_to_course_section.description: Restrict the user to seeing and interacting with users in course_section_id only

user_id.description: The Canvas user ID to enroll

name: enroll_user
title: Enroll User
